checklist.text: Within a few minutes you see birds sit for a while and preen, scratch, fluff or stretch
The garden still feels lively, not frozen (if not, lower Sit still)
A sitting bird that gets hungry gets up and goes to eat

description: Wandering birds used to stop for only 0.8-2.5 s, so idle acts almost never got to play. Now about 1 in 5 standing stops (not pecks) becomes a 10-40 s sit: the bird stays put, looks about and turns a little, and hunger ends it. Idle-act gaps cut from 8-20 s to 4-10 s. New slider: Tools panel, Bird behavior, "Sit still" (`SimTuning.SitChance`); sit length `SitMin`/`SitMax` at the top of `BirdMover.cs`. Workspace sample: one followed bird stood 26% of 150 s, with one 22 s sit.
title: 5.13 Sit spells, idle acts more often
